scope: Exact monitor extracted from production test tool; virtual clock/video/counters, no TV or build

results.name: initial observation does not count existing cumulative frames
repeated snapshots count only frame differences
over-three-second gap preserves buffer state and nearby event evidence
advancing closes the original gap without creating duplicates
natural loop splits segment even when ended was sampled earlier
counter reset starts a new segment without summing cumulative counts
unavailable counters are explicitly null and incomplete
cleanup removes all listeners, intervals and monitor ownership
